principles.title: Impartiality
principles.text: Certification decisions are made independently of commercial interests. We regularly analyse risks to impartiality and eliminate them.

principles.title: Competence
principles.text: Work is carried out by qualified specialists, and testing takes place in laboratories accredited to ISO/IEC 17025.

principles.title: Confidentiality
principles.text: Information about the applicant and its products obtained during certification is not disclosed to third parties, except where the law requires it.

principles.title: Openness
principles.text: Our certification procedure and schemes are published on this site. Any of our decisions can be appealed, and complaints can be filed online.

steps.text: We check the documents and choose the certification scheme together with the applicant.

steps.title: Samples and testing
steps.text: We identify the product, take samples and test them in an accredited laboratory.

steps.title: Certificate

steps.title: Periodic assessment
steps.text: For serial products, during the certificate's validity, where the scheme provides for it.

about.detailsNameValue: Standart and Quality Assessment Group LLC
about.ctaText: Send us a request and we will advise on the certification scheme, timing and required documents.
story: SQA Group was founded in Tashkent in 2013. From day one we have worked with manufacturers and importers in Uzbekistan, helping them prove what matters most: that their products are safe and meet the requirements.

The experience built up over those years became the basis for accreditation. In January 2022 the Uzbek Accreditation Centre (O'ZAKK) accredited our certification body to ISO/IEC 17065 and our testing laboratory to ISO/IEC 17025.

In 2025 the accreditation certificates were reissued, and in May 2026 a second accredited laboratory, S-LAB, joined us. Today the certification body's scope covers 188 product types, from polymer pipes and linoleum to furniture, tableware and playground equipment.

Our work now goes beyond product certification. We help companies prepare for management system certification and, together with our German partner AC Inorms GmbH, obtain certificates and permits for export to Europe. Exporters from Uzbekistan and across Central Asia handle all of this with us in Tashkent, in Russian or Uzbek.
What matters most to us has not changed since 2013: impartiality, precision and respect for our clients' time.

financing.title: Sources of financing
financing.intro: Information about the body's financial stability and independence.
financing.p1: The body's activities are financed by income from certification and testing services. Service fees are set by approved tariffs and applied equally to all clients.

schemes.title: Certification schemes
schemes.intro: The product certification schemes currently in force in the Republic of Uzbekistan and how they differ.
schemes.noticeText: Cabinet of Ministers Resolution No. 318 of 06.07.2004 lost force on 9 September 2026 under Resolution No. 472 of 07.09.2026. Product certification, like all conformity assessment, is now carried out under the Regulation on the product certification procedure (Annex 2 to Resolution No. 502 of 14.08.2024).
schemes.schemesText: The scheme depends on the product and how it is supplied: serial production, a consignment or a single item. Where a technical regulation allows several schemes, the applicant chooses.

2S.title: Serial products with a certified management system
2S.text: For serial products of a manufacturer holding a management system certificate.

3S.title: Consignment
3S.text: For a consignment of products. Certification can be done before import into Uzbekistan; the applicant is responsible for sampling and delivering the samples to the certification body. Imported products are marked in a form convenient to the applicant.

3A.title: Supplies under one foreign trade contract
3A.text: For identical goods imported under one foreign trade contract, except vehicles. The certificate is issued once, for no longer than one calendar year. Introduced by Resolution No. 472 of 07.09.2026.

4S.title: Single item
4S.text: For one item, provided the tests and measurements required by the technical regulation do not damage it.

5S.title: Serial products not fully verifiable by testing
5S.text: For serial products whose conformity cannot be fully confirmed by testing and measuring the finished product.

6S.title: The same, with a management system
6S.text: For serial products whose conformity cannot be fully confirmed by testing the finished product, where the manufacturer holds a management system certificate.

7S.title: Serial products with modifications
7S.text: For serial products where the manufacturer plans to release modifications.

8S.title: Modifications with a management system
8S.text: For serial products with planned modifications, where the manufacturer holds a management system certificate.

9S.title: Equipment for enterprises
9S.text: For single items intended to equip enterprises in Uzbekistan. Certification is based on an analysis of the technical documentation.

validity.title: Serial products
validity.text: 3 years. Products made during this period count as certified and are not re-certified.

validity.title: Consignment
validity.text: For the product's shelf life or warranty period.

validity.title: Scheme 3A
validity.text: Issued once, for no longer than one calendar year.

schemes.markText1: Products certified under schemes 1C, 2C, 3C, 3A, 5C, 6C, 7C and 8C are marked with the conformity mark.
schemes.markText2: From 12 October 2026 the national information system "Technical Regulation" automatically adds the conformity mark to certificates issued under these schemes.
schemes.markText3: Manufacturers and importers receive the right to use the mark under an agreement with the body that issued the certificate; a one-time fee is charged for its use (Article 28 of the Law "On Technical Regulation").
schemes.noteText: Our specialists will advise free of charge on the right scheme, timing and documents. Send us a request.

appeals.title: Appeals & complaints
appeals.intro: How to file an appeal against certification body decisions, or submit complaints and suggestions.
appeals.p1: A complaint or appeal is accepted in written form, registered, and the applicant is notified of receipt by email.
appeals.p2: The submission is reviewed by the responsible team under the principles of impartiality and confidentiality. Additional documents may be requested when needed, and the final response is sent in writing.
appeals.downloadText: To submit a complaint or appeal, download the official form, complete the required information and send us the signed copy.
appeals.downloadNote: The document is provided in Word format. Once completed, it may be sent by email or submitted as a printed copy.

items.title: Management systems
items.text: We help you prepare for and pass management system certification — ISO 9001 (quality), ISO 14001 (environment), ISO 45001 (occupational safety), ISO 22000 (food safety): documentation, internal audit and support until the certificate is issued by an accredited body.

items.title: Export to Europe
items.text: Certificates and permits for the European market for exporters from Uzbekistan and across Central Asia. We work with AC Inorms GmbH (Germany): you deal with us in Tashkent, and we handle the European side.

items.title: Conformity mark
items.text: Products certified under schemes 1C, 2C, 3C, 3A and 5C–8C carry the conformity mark (muvofiqlik belgisi). From 12 October 2026 the mark is added to the certificate automatically in the national "Technical Regulation" system.
